audience_label: Professional investors only — not for retail distribution

strategy.description: A synthetic example used to exercise the factsheet layout. The described strategy takes systematic exposure to a single risk premium, scales that exposure to a fixed volatility target, and reduces it as drawdown deepens. No figure on this sheet is a real measurement.

performance.chart_caption: PLACEHOLDER CHART — geometric stand-in sized to the real figure footprint, not data.

methodology: Exposure is set monthly from a trailing realised-volatility estimate and targets a fixed annualised index volatility, subject to a notional cap.
A de-risking overlay reduces exposure as the trailing peak-to-trough decline deepens.
Every figure in this fixture is synthetic. Nothing here was simulated, back-tested or measured; the numbers are round so that they cannot be mistaken for results.
footnotes: Synthetic fixture data. SI = since inception.
